title: Host SSH Provisioning Variables
description: Variables for the provision_host role's SSH provisioning operations. Names are flat, camelCase, and prefixed with provisionHostSsh.

provisionHostSshOperation.description: Reusable provisioning operation selected by a thin playbook. provision performs the full safe cutover; disable_password always invokes shared SSH validation before hardening sshd.

provisionHostSshUser.description: Non-root login account whose authorized_keys file receives the generated public key. Defaults to ansible_user prepared from user-<short-hostname>, then hostUserName.

provisionHostSshHost.description: Hostname or address used by the controller for the independent SSH validation. Defaults to ansible_host, then inventory_hostname.

provisionHostSshPort.description: SSH port used by independent validation and the 1Password bookmark. Defaults to ansible_port, then 22.

provisionHostSshItemName.description: Exact 1Password SSH Key item title. Defaults to sshkey-<short-hostname>, excluding .local, DNS, and Tailnet suffixes.

provisionHostSshKeyType.description: Key type passed to op item create --ssh-generate-key when the item does not exist.

provisionHostSshOpTokenFile.description: Controller path containing a 1Password service-account token with read/write access to onePasswordVault.

provisionHostSshSshdDropIn.description: Managed sshd drop-in replaced during password-authentication hardening. Defaults to the zeroBringup bootstrap drop-in.

provisionHostSshStrictHostKeyChecking.description: StrictHostKeyChecking policy for independent validation. The accept-new default pins the first host key for the remainder of the current playbook run; ephemeral trust resets on the next run.

provisionHostSshValidationTimeout.description: OpenSSH ConnectTimeout in seconds for an independent key-only validation attempt.

provisionHostSshValidationExtraArgs.description: Additional controller ssh argv entries placed before the host, for example ['-J', 'bastion.example.net'].

provisionHostSshAddBookmark.description: Add or update an ssh:// URL field on the 1Password SSH Key item for SSH Agent bookmark matching. Defaults to true.
